text: Pigu.lt belongs to PHH Group, the Baltic e-commerce group formed by merging Pigu.lt with Finland's Hobby Hall; PHH Group's shareholders are led by Mid Europa Partners.

source.name: Žalgiris (club site): „Pigu.lt“ pradeda partnerystę su Kauno „Žalgirio“ krepšinio klubu
source.quote: „Pigu.lt“ priklauso didžiausiai Baltijos šalyse e. prekybos bendrovei „PHH Group“
source.note: Lithuanian. Translation: 'Pigu.lt belongs to the largest Baltic e-commerce company PHH Group'. Club's announcement of the Pigu.lt partnership.

additionalSources.name: 15min.lt: Akcininkai į „Pigu Hobby Hall Group“ augimą investuos daugiau nei 20 mln. eurų
additionalSources.note: Lithuanian. Translation: 'shareholders, led by the company MidEuropa'. States PHH Group's shareholders are led by Mid Europa Partners and that Pigu.lt belongs to PHH Group.
